title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
summary: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.

title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
summary: A $5.8 million loss on Bitcoin options pushed operating revenue below zero, and higher Bitcoin prices lifted net income to $85.5 million.

title: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
summary: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.

title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
summary: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.

title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
summary: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.

title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
summary: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.

title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
summary: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook email and Teams calendars worldwide
summary: Microsoft began a wider patch rollout Friday as the outage disrupted government email and Microsoft 365 connectors in ChatGPT and Claude.

title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.
